arxiv-2207-01998.title: Schrödinger operators with oblique transmission conditions in ℝ 2 {\mathbb{R}}^{2}
arxiv-2207-01998.creator: Jussi Behrndt, Markus Holzmann, Georg Stenzel
arxiv-2207-01998.description: Abstract . In this paper we study the spectrum of self-adjoint Schrödinger operators in L 2 ​ ( ℝ 2 ) L^{2}(\mathbb{R}^{2}) with a new type of transmission conditions along a smooth closed curve Σ ⊆ ℝ 2 \Sigma\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{2} .

arxiv-2210-08012.title: A geospatial bounded confidence model including mega-influencers with an application to Covid-19 vaccine hesitancy
arxiv-2210-08012.creator: Anna Haensch, Natasa Dragovic, Christoph Börgers, Bruce Boghosian
arxiv-2210-08012.description: Abstract . We introduce a geospatial bounded confidence model with mega-influencers, inspired by Hegselmann and Krause. The inclusion of geography gives rise to large-scale geospatial patterns evolving out of random initial data; that is, spatial clusters of like-minded agents emerge regardless of initialization. Mega-influencers and stochasticity amplify this effect, and soften local consensus.

arxiv-2212-10095.title: Search for a heavy neutrino in τ \tau decays at Belle
arxiv-2212-10095.creator: D. Liventsev, I. Adachi, H. Aihara, S. Al Said, D. M. Asner, H. Atmacan, R. Ayad, V. Babu, Sw. Banerjee, M. Bauer, P. Behera, K. Belous, J. Bennett, M. Bessner, T. Bilka, D. Biswas, D. Bodrov, G. Bonvicini, J. Borah, A. Bozek, M. Bračko, P. Branchini, T. E. Browder, A. Budano, M. Campajola, D. Červe
arxiv-2212-10095.description: Abstract We report on a search for a heavy Majorana neutrino in the decays τ − → π − ​ ν h \tau^{-}\to\pi^{-}\nu_{h} , ν h → π ± ​ ℓ ∓ \nu_{h}\to\pi^{\pm}\ell^{\mp} , ℓ = e , μ \ell=e,\mu .

arxiv-2404-16447.title: Hardy decomposition of higher order Lipschitz classes by polymonogenic functions
arxiv-2404-16447.creator: Lianet De la Cruz Toranzo, Ricardo Abreu Blaya, Swanhild Bernstein
arxiv-2404-16447.description: Abstract In this paper we find a decomposition of higher order Lipschitz functions into the traces of a polymonogenic function and solve a related Riemann-Hilbert problem. Our approach lies in using a cliffordian Cauchy-type operator, which behaves as an involution operator on higher order Lipschitz spaces.

arxiv-2409-14219.title: MEGA-PT: A Meta-Game Framework for Agile Penetration Testing
arxiv-2409-14219.creator: Yunfei Ge, Quanyan Zhu
arxiv-2409-14219.description: Abstract Penetration testing is an essential means of proactive defense in the face of escalating cybersecurity incidents. Traditional manual penetration testing methods are time-consuming, resource-intensive, and prone to human errors. Current trends in automated penetration testing are also impractical, facing significant challenges such as the curse of dimensionality, scalability issues, and lack of adaptability to network changes.

arxiv-2509-09995.title: QuantAgent: Price-Driven Multi-Agent LLMs for High-Frequency Trading
arxiv-2509-09995.creator: Fei Xiong, Xiang Zhang, Aosong Feng, Siqi Sun, Chenyu You
arxiv-2509-09995.description: Abstract Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in financial reasoning and market understanding. Multi-agent LLM frameworks such as TradingAgent and FINMEM augment these models to long-horizon investment tasks by leveraging fundamental and sentiment-based inputs for strategic decision-making. However, these approaches are ill-suited for the high-speed, precision-critical demands of High-Frequency Trading (HFT).

pmc-10531340.title: Cross-Cultural Adaptation, Reliability, and Validity of the Greek Version of the Fremantle Shoulder Awareness Questionnaire (FreSHAQ-GR) in Patients with Chronic Shoulder Pain
pmc-10531340.creator: George A Koumantakis, Emmanouil Sifakis, Panagiotis Stathis, Spyridon Gigourtakis, Petros I Tatsios, Eleftherios Paraskevopoulos, Maria Moutzouri, Sotiria Vrouva, Arnold Wong
pmc-10531340.description: Shoulder pain is one of the most common musculoskeletal pathologies. The association of shoulder pain with impaired proprioception and bodily self-awareness called for the cross-cultural adaptation of the Fremantle Shoulder Awareness Questionnaire (FreSHAQ) in Greek. The FreSHAQ is a relatively new self-assessment 9-item scale for impaired somatic awareness in patients with shoulder pain.

pmc-10556817.title: Construction and application of adenoviral vectors
pmc-10556817.creator: Hongbo Zhang, Hongdan Wang, Youcai An, Ze Chen
pmc-10556817.description: Adenoviral vectors have been widely used as vaccine candidates or potential vaccine candidates against infectious diseases due to the convenience of genome manipulation, their ability to accommodate large exogenous gene fragments, easy access of obtaining high-titer of virus, and high efficiency of transduction.

pmc-10642578.title: qEEG as Biomarker for Alzheimer’s Disease: Investigating Relative PSD Difference and Coherence Analysis
pmc-10642578.creator: Chanda Simfukwe, Su-Hyun Han, Ho Tae Jeong, Young Chul Youn
pmc-10642578.description: PurposeElectroencephalography (EEG) is a non-intrusive technique that provides comprehensive insights into the electrical activities of the brain’s cerebral cortex. The brain signals obtained from EEGs can be used as a neuropsychological biomarker to detect different stages of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) through quantitative EEG (qEEG) analysis.

pmc-11507007.title: Molecular Phylogenetics and Mitochondrial Genomic Evolution in the Endemic Genus Pielomastax (Orthoptera: Eumastacoidea) in China
pmc-11507007.creator: Jun-Hui Lu, Keyao Zhang, Sheng-Quan Xu, Ying Ding, Stefano Lonardi
pmc-11507007.description: Background/Objectives: The genus Pielomastax Chang (Orthoptera: Eumastacoidea, 1937) is endemic to China, which is mainly distributed in low- and medium-altitude areas in central and eastern China. However, there are relatively few molecular data studies on the genus Pielomastax. Methods: In this study, three species of the genus Pielomastax were collected from Hubei and Henan, China, namely Pielomastax sp.

pmc-11516658.title: Multilevel Sexual Minority Stigma-Based Experiences and Mental Health Among U.S. Sexual Minority Adults: A Socio-Ecological Longitudinal Moderated Mediation Analysis
pmc-11516658.creator: A van der Star, H Bos
pmc-11516658.description: BackgroundThe current study aimed to longitudinally examine whether intrapersonal stigma (i.e., internalized stigma; identity concealment) mediates the associations between interpersonal stigma (i.e., adulthood and childhood victimization; everyday discrimination; perceived external stigma) and mental health outcomes among sexual minority adults, and as a function of two moderators: structural climate and generation.MethodsData from 600 sexual minorities across three generations (i.e.

pmc-11712119.title: The effects of six months of the adapted Otago Exercise Program on cognition and falls relative to usual care alone among people living with dementia in residential care facilities: A pilot feasibility randomized controlled trial
pmc-11712119.creator: Deborah A Jehu
pmc-11712119.description: BackgroundThere are no evidence‐based exercise guidelines to reduce falls in people living with dementia (PWD). The purpose of this pilot randomized controlled trial (RCT) was to determine the 1) feasibility and acceptability, and 2) effect of exercise on cognition and falls (exploratory) relative to usual care alone among PWD.

pmc-11935569.title: The ABCs of Subarachnoid Hemorrhage Blood Volume Measurement: A Simplified Quantitative Method Predicts Outcomes and Delayed Cerebral Ischemia
pmc-11935569.creator: Fabian Föttinger, Rohan Sharma, Saif D. Salman, Alexander D. Weston, Bradley J. Erickson, Thien Huynh, Rabih G. Tawk, William D. Freeman
pmc-11935569.description: BackgroundWe developed a simplified ABC/2‐derived method to estimate total subarachnoid hemorrhage volume (SAHV) on noncontrast computed tomography in patients with aneurysmal SAH and compared the clinical and radiographic outcomes.Methods and ResultsIn this retrospective observational cohort study, we analyzed 277 patients with SAH admitted to our Comprehensive Stroke Center between 2012 and 2022.

pmc-12543130.title: ABO blood groups and cardiovascular disease and its risk in continental Africans and people of African ancestry: A systematic review
pmc-12543130.creator: Francis Broni, James Abugri, Samuel Mawuli Adadey, Victor Asoala, Patrick Ansah, Godfred Agongo
pmc-12543130.description: BackgroundCardiovascular disease (CVD) remains a global health challenge and contributes substantially to mortality burden in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) in particular. Several factors, including particular blood group types in the ABO system, have been associated with CVD risk. However, the direction of the association of ABO blood groups with CVD remains controversial.

pmc-12644417.title: Refractory tardive dyskinesia in the critical care setting: A case report of successful use of phenobarbital
pmc-12644417.creator: Abdelrahman S Abdalla, Uzayr Syed, Marina Girgis, Chad K Brands, Syed Aslam
pmc-12644417.description: Tardive dyskinesia is a hyperkinetic movement disorder most often induced by chronic antipsychotic use. It can be challenging to treat, particularly when symptoms persist despite standard therapies such as vesicular monoamine transporter 2 inhibitors. We describe a 37-year-old male with schizoaffective disorder and persistent tardive dyskinesia involving oro-buccal-lingual and axial movements.

pmc-13155608.title: Hiding in plain sight: A call to prevent cutaneous leishmaniasis transmission in the United States
pmc-13155608.creator: Juan David Ramírez, Sarah M. Gunter, Megan Coffee, Norman Beatty, Dawn M. Wetzel
pmc-13155608.description: Cutaneous leishmaniasis (CL), once considered a travel-associated tropical disease, is increasingly transmitted within the United States, particularly in southern regions. Despite mounting evidence of local transmission, public health recognition and preventive infrastructure remain limited. This Viewpoint highlights the urgent need to shift the U.S. CL response from questioning endemicity to preventing transmission.

pmc-13195855.title: Outcomes after laparoscopic transhiatal esophagectomy for siewert type I esophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13195855.creator: Saeed Sadreniac, Hassan Mohammadpour, Ali Yavari, Shima Nasirnia, Mahdi Mohebbi, Amirhossein Karimi, Sina Salimi Nasab, Amir Abbas Bagheri, Farzad Dehghani Mahmoudabadi, Seyed Mohamad Hossein Tabatabaei Nodoushan, Amin Esfandiari Kalajahi, Mohammad Mehdi Shadravan, Helia Ghorbani
pmc-13195855.description: BackgroundSiewert type I esophagogastric junction (EGJ) adenocarcinoma remains surgically challenging, and the role of transhiatal esophagectomy (THE) is debated, particularly in high-incidence and resource-variable settings.MethodsThis two-center retrospective cohort study included 101 adults with Siewert type I EGJ adenocarcinoma who underwent laparoscopic THE (January 2020–December 2022).

pmc-13246946.title: Cognitive Radio for Satellite TT & C System: A General Dataset Using Software-defined Radio
pmc-13246946.creator: Yi Zhang, Bo Zang, Hongbing Ji, Lin Li, Shiyao Li, Leyan Chen
pmc-13246946.description: The rapid advancement of satellite communication systems necessitates the integration of cognitive radio technologies to ensure system adaptability. However, existing public datasets are predominantly centered on terrestrial signal features, severely constraining their applicability in space environments. Here, we introduce RML24, the first open-source benchmark dataset specifically engineered for deep learning-based satellite Telemetry, Tracking, and Command (TT&C) signal processing.

pmc-13373264.title: The influence of social support on the relationship between HIV-related stigma, mental health and suicidality among young women living with HIV in South Africa: A moderated mediation analysis
pmc-13373264.creator: Wylene Saal, Siyanai Zhou, Christina Laurenzi, Kathryn J. Steventon Roberts, Lulama Sidloyi, Babalwa Taleni, Lucie Cluver, Elona Toska, Guilherme Welter Wendt, Guilherme Welter Wendt
pmc-13373264.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Adolescent girls and young women (AGYW) living with HIV are at increased risk of developing suicidality. Yet little is known about the effects of HIV-related stigma, mental health challenges and social support on suicidality among AGYW living with HIV. We analysed cross-sectional data from 711 AGYW living with HIV who participated in two large prospective South African cohort studies, Mzantsi Wakho (2017–2018) and HEY BABY (2018–2019).

pmc-13417106.title: Growth Characteristics, Growing Medium Properties, and Leaf Nutrient Contents of Silene compacta Fisch. Seedlings at Two Growing Periods Under Standardized Nursery Conditions
pmc-13417106.creator: Selma Kösa, Sibel Mansuroğlu
pmc-13417106.description: Despite the increasing interest in Silene compacta Fisch. as a landscape plant, its greenhouse cultivation protocols remain poorly explored, leaving a critical gap in optimizing seedling production duration and efficiency. Therefore, this study aimed to compare the growth characteristics, growing medium properties, and leaf nutrient contents of S. compacta seedlings grown for two different periods (2.5 and 4.

pmc-13664678.title: Gaming disorder prevention among adolescents in Japan: Challenges and future directions
pmc-13664678.creator: Kai Kobayashi, Tsubasa Sasaki, Eiji Shimizu
pmc-13664678.description: valence among adolescents, prevention of GD is urgently needed. This article reviews domestic and international preventive policies and initiatives and discusses GD prevention tailored to Japanese adolescents. Given the limited research on GD prevention, this letter focuses on GD while considering prevention studies on related concepts, including problematic internet use, internet addiction, and internet use disorder.

the-napoleon-of-notting-hill.title: The Napoleon of Notting Hill
the-napoleon-of-notting-hill.creator: Chesterton, Gilbert K.; W. Graham Robertson
the-napoleon-of-notting-hill.description: In a London of the future, the drudgery of capitalism and bureaucracy have worn the human spirit down to the point where it can barely stand.
